name: 403 PUPPET
source:
A puppet stops you on your way home.

"I'm not a puppet, I am a real person!" he claims.

He needs your help escaping his puppet box!

[from [url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/403-puppet]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个木偶在你回家的路上拦住了你。

“我不是傀儡，我是真人！”他声称。

他需要你的帮助才能逃离他的傀儡盒子！

[来自[url=https://pacchistudio.itch.io/403-puppet]itch.io[/url]]
